text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy put on a fierce performance 
in the Teio Sho! The stands began buzzing 
once again...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! Whoaaa...! I just got chills...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! Just how much stronger are you 
gonna get, Windy-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! Did you see that beastly 
running?! I knew it, she's amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! That girl... she's really 
strong...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... They're totally freaked 
out.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm drawing closer... to my ambition...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling great, so I'm gonna go say hi 
to the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAWWWWWRRR!! ROOOAAARRRRRR!!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Windy-chan!? Kyaaah! That was totally 
awesome~~!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
"I really... was watching you the whole 
time...! Watching you run your heart out 
without looking back...!"

"I want all of Japan to recognize her true 
strength, just like this...!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...The news Biko told me was, well, 
pretty decent too!"

Shinko Windy is in high spirits after 
checking the news Biko Pegasus told her 
about before the race.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"‘Beast of the Dirt’...! ‘Razor-sharp late 
burst’...! ‘Terrifying focus’...! And 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, she'll bite back with a 
vengeance through her running. A truly 
formidable Umamusume to watch out for." 
...It says!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan's 'infamy' is spreading 
further and further...!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~n♪ I wanna be told things like that 
even more!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Minion! Aren't there any races where I can 
show off Windy-chan's terrifying might 
even more!?

"The Champions Cup held in winter. If you 
win a Central GⅠ in front of such a 
massive crowd, you'll draw far more 
attention than ever before."

She had proven her undeniable strength in 
the February Stakes and the Teio Sho at 
the start and middle of the Senior tier. 
If she could make a statement in a GI at 
the end of the year as well—
choice_data_list: Everyone will tremble at your strength!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah! Then let's go with that one!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll win by an absolute landslide... and 
scare the pants off eeeveryone...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna grab everyone's attention so 
hard that no one can look away!

And so, our next goal became the Champions 
Cup. We'll train thoroughly until winter 
and make sure we win.
